routes.name: Visa-free entry (52 countries)
routes.summary: Citizens of 52 listed countries, including the US, Canada, Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Thailand, can stay 30 days per entry without a visa. Register with internal affairs within 10 working days unless exempt.

other: Full list is on the Tajik MFA site

stay.note: Per entry, extendable under Tajik law

sources.label: Tajik MFA, Brussels embassy visa page

routes.name: Tajikistan e-Visa
routes.summary: Apply online at evisa.tj. It is valid 90 days. The embassy pages disagree on max stay, 45 or 60 days, so check evisa.tj before you book.

other: GBAO region needs a separate permit

stay.note: Embassy pages say 45 days (Brussels) or 60 days (Malaysia). Single entry, not extendable per Brussels page.

sources.label: Tajik MFA, Brussels embassy visa page

routes.name: Standard visa (embassy)
routes.summary: Categories include transit, business, student, labor, private, investor and tourist. Apply online first, then visit an embassy for fingerprints and payment. Requirements and fees per category are not on the page.

other: Passport with 2 blank pages, valid 6 months past the visa
Stays over 3 months usually need an HIV/AIDS-free medical certificate

sources.label: Tajik MFA, Brussels embassy visa page
